item.title: ⚡️ In connection with Ukrainian statements aimed at creating direct threats to civil aviation
item.description: ⚡️ In connection with Ukrainian statements aimed at creating direct threats to civil aviation , the competent Russian authorities are in contact with the leadership of the International Civil Aviation Organization ( #ICAO ) in Montreal. An urgent appeal on the matter has been sent to ICAO Secretary General Juan Carlos Salazar . ❗️ The Russian Federation has issued a strong protest over Ukraine’s reckless terrorist actions, which run counter to international law. The NOTAMs issued by the Ukrainian authorities alleging that Russian airspace is unsafe have been categorically rejected . They have no legal force , distort the actual situation and mislead users of Russian airspace . We called on the ICAO Secretary General to condemn the Kiev regime’s unlawful interference in civil aviation and the direct threats it is creating, and to take targeted steps to put an end to these actions by Ukraine. ☝️ The Russian Federation remains firmly committed to ensuring the safety of civil aviation.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 4, a meeting between heads of highest judicial bodies of Russia and India
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇳 On September 4, a meeting between heads of highest judicial bodies of Russia and India Igor Krasnov and Surya Kant was held on the sidelines of the BRICS Chief Justices’ Forum in New Delhi. The sides discussed coordination of efforts on the international stage and reaffirmed the continuity of the course aimed at strengthening previously reached agreements. Igor Krasnov stated that deepening Russian-Indian cooperation based on the principles of special and privileged strategic partnership is underpinned by the warm personal and friendly relations between the leaders of our countries, Vladimir Putin and Narendra Modi . 🤝 During the talks, the previously signed Memorandum of Understanding was highly praised. The Russian side has already prepared and submitted to its partners for consideration a draft Programme for cooperation for the next two years. The document includes a list of mutually beneficial initiatives. #RussiaIndia #DruzhbaDosti

by Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at a lecture hosted by
the Russian Znanie Society

the 11th Eastern Economic Forum
(Vladivostok, September 3, 2026)
Key points
:
• We are not building walls, nor do we want to cut ourselves off from Europe.
It is Europe that has cut itself off from us.
It apparently believed that our past cooperation mattered so much to Russia that we would come running back and beg:
“All right, forgive us, forget what happened. Let us return – just lift the sanctions”.
That is not going to happen.
•
NATO and the EU – always need an enemy.
Without an artificially created image of Russia as the enemy,
people would get rid of their governments
in the overwhelming majority of EU and NATO countries.
• When German Chancellor
Friedrich Merz
said
that he would once again make Germany Europe’s leading military power, I was simply stunned.
If this person does not understand what the word “again” means in this context, that is deeply troubling and extremely dangerous for Europe
, which is once again becoming a source of ideas of national and racial superiority.
• Germany has
Goethe-Institut
branches in Moscow, St Petersburg and Novosibirsk.
Of course, they will be closed after
our cultural centre was expelled from Germany
. Otherwise, we would have no self-respect.
• If the legislative prohibition of the Russian language in education, culture, daily life, and the media reflects European values,
then Europe is welcome to revert to Nazism
. The ban on the canonical Ukrainian Orthodox Church likewise aligns with “European values”.
•
The principles on which we, and everyone else, recognised Ukraine’s independence
were thrown on the scrap heap long ago.
Yet the West continues to defend Ukraine as a country supposedly standing up for “European values”. Meanwhile,
the EU has economically shot itself in both the foot and the head
, and in other parts of the body as well, by rejecting Russian energy supplies and
blowing up the Nord Stream pipelines
.

The Embassy of Ukraine in Jakarta has recently spread the comment claiming that at least eight Indonesian citizens who visited Russia allegedly joined Russian Armed Forces – is a

Ukraine itself is actively recruiting foreign mercenaries
into the ranks of its military formations. This is due to their significant losses on the battlefield – over 700,000 killed and 1 million wounded. The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense has stated that, in the long term, its army should consist of 30–50% foreigners. Kiev employs
deceptive methods
and makes use of diplomatic missions and affiliated organizations abroad to recruit them. Tens of thousands of citizens from the other countries are currently serving in the Ukrainian army.
Several thousand people died, Indonesian citizens were also among them.
The Ukrainian Embassy’s allegations about Kiev’s adherence to international humanitarian law and the humane treatment of prisoners of war are
extremely cynical
. The majority of the prisoners of war who returned from Ukraine as part of prisoners’ exchanges reported torture, abuse, and cruel treatment while in captivity.
It is obvious that the anti-Russian disinformation campaign held by the Ukrainian Embassy was timed to coincide with the participation of President of Indonesia Prabowo Subianto in
the XI Eastern Economic Forum
in Vladivostok and
aimed at damaging the Russian-Indonesian relations

item.title: 🎙 Comment by Ambassador of Russia to Canada Oleg Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney's
item.description: 🎙 Comment by Ambassador of Russia to Canada Oleg Stepanov to The Canadian Press News Agency on recent Prime-Minister Mark Carney's remarks ( Ottawa, September 3, 2026 ) ❗️ I am compelled to correct Prime Minister Carney. Russia was, remains and will remain a member of the Group of Twenty. As for the fate of the G8 format, it ceased to exist in 2014. Let me recall how this came about. In 2014, Moscow held the presidency of the group. Following Crimea’s reunification with Russia , the other seven members decided, for political reasons, to withdraw from the G8 format. In other words, they excluded themselves. ☝️ The G8 no longer exists. And that is perhaps for the best. We have no interest in reviving it . In contemporary international affairs, it is new-type formats such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation and BRICS , as well as the aforementioned Group of Twenty, that command the greatest authority. The G7, by contrast, has long since become a grouping that exists on paper only, perpetuated merely for its own sake. Whatever prestige it may once have enjoyed no longer carries any weight in contemporary international relations. Such is the reality.

item.title: 🇷🇺 Consulate General of Russia in Cape Town Article by R.Golubovskiy, the Consul General of Russia in Cape Town, published in the Cape Times (media holding Independent Media), on t
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇿🇦 Consulate General of Russia in Cape Town : ✍🏻 Article by R.Golubovskiy, the Consul General of Russia in Cape Town, published in the Cape Times (media holding Independent Media), on the topic of partnership between the EAEU and the SACU. "Bridging Eurasia and Southern Africa: Strategic Prospects for EAEU-SACU Relations" Key points: - Against the backdrop of the fragmentation of the global economy and the growing role of regional integration associations, cooperation between the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) and the Southern African Customs Union (SACU) is of practical interest as one of the avenues for strengthening economic ties between Eurasia and Southern Africa. - The existence of a similar customs framework creates favourable conditions for the gradual establishment of an institutional dialogue between the EAEU and SACU. - The fact that both associations face comparable structural challenges including the need to diversify their economies, develop infrastructure, enhance competitiveness and adapt to changes in global trade – also creates potential for cooperation. 👉🏻 Read in full in English: PressReader Telegraph

item.title: 💬 Embassy comment on the British side’s démarche On 3 September, Chargé d’Affaires
item.description: Embassy comment on the British side’s démarche 💬 On 3 September, Chargé d’Affaires Vasily Tsyganov was invited to the Foreign Office, where he received a protest alleging Russia’s involvement in the drone incident at Leipzig Airport. These baseless and absurd accusations, framed in a surprisingly familiar British style, were categorically rejected. No convincing evidence was presented to support the anti-Russian version of events. The Russian side pointed out that such a coordinated provocation, aimed at fuelling tension in Europe, serves only the interests of Kiev and its sponsors, who are pushing for the conflict to continue. It is reckless and dangerous. ☝️ It was stressed that Russia does not seek confrontation with the United Kingdom or other European states. However, any escalatory steps on their part will meet an appropriate and carefully calibrated response.

item.title: : Government of the Russian Federation On September 3, Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov and Vice Premier of the State Council of China Ding Xuexiang
item.description: Government of the Russian Federation : 🇷🇺 🇨🇳 On September 3, Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov and Vice Premier of the State Council of China Ding Xuexiang held a meeting of the Russia-China Intergovernmental Commission on Investment Cooperation on the sidelines of the 11th Eastern Economic Forum . In the first half of 2026, Russia-China trade grew by 22% and exceeded $135 billion . 💬 Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov : Expanding investment cooperation helps lay a solid foundation for further sustainable growth in trade. Creating comfortable and predictable conditions for the continued expansion of investment cooperation remains our priority . Joint Russia-China initiatives supported by the Commission include around 90 projects worth approximately $240 billion . More than half are already at the implementation stage. Joint projects are being carried out in metallurgy, chemicals and forestry, mechanical engineering, agriculture, transport, trade and logistics. ☝️ The Commission’s key areas of work in the near term include : • continuous monitoring and targeted support for projects; • raising business awareness of investment opportunities; • developing new mechanisms and instruments to attract financing for investment projects. #RussiaChina

🎙
Address
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the Plenary Session of
the 11th Eastern Economic Forum
(Vladivostok, Russky Island, September 3, 2026)
The event
was also attended by President of Indonesia
Prabowo Subianto
, Prime Minister of Mongolia
Nyam-Osoryn Uchral
, Vice President of Myanmar
U Nyo Saw
, and Vice Premier of the State Council of China
Ding Xuexiang
.
Key points
:
•
Russia is an active participant in investment and trade cooperation in the Asia-Pacific
. We engage with our partners and the region’s leading integration associations on an equal footing.
•
Our strategic objective is to ensure that the Far East remains a region of cooperation and dynamic transformation
in the economy and infrastructure, technological development, workforce training and, of course, the social sphere.
•
Over the past 11 years, around 25 trillion rubles in capital investment
has been attracted to Russia’s Far Eastern regions
. As a result, the Far East’s gross regional product has more than tripled over this period – a very strong pace of growth.
•
The Far East’s key macroeconomic indicators are growing faster than the national average
. This is precisely what we sought to achieve when we declared the region’s development a strategic priority for Russia throughout the 21st century.
•
It is important to continue creating
convenient and predictable conditions for investors
, taking into account the needs of businesses and the regions while proceeding from Russia’s national interests.
•
For investors in such projects
,
and for those launching new enterprises in the Far East and the Arctic
,
it is important to ensure stable demand for their products
. Offset contracts, which are being developed with the support of
State Development Corporation VEB.RF
, should be used for this purpose as well.
• In today’s challenging global environment, amid risks to international shipping and trade,
the Northern Sea Route
is intended to provide greater flexibility and security for international deliveries
, open up new opportunities for transit and coastal shipping, and ensure uninterrupted supplies to Arctic regions.
•
Our goal is to make navigation along the Trans-Arctic Transport Corridor year-round
. To achieve this, we are building icebreakers and ice-class vessels, expanding our service and rescue fleet and satellite constellation, and strengthening port infrastructure.
• We expect that by the end of this decade,
freight traffic along the Trans-Arctic Corridor will reach at least 70 million tonnes per year
– at least double the current level.
• To expand international capital participation in our Far Eastern and Arctic projects,
we need to make use of the potential of
the Eastern Exchange
. As I have already said, we plan to establish a modern financial centre on its basis.
•
We need to develop
new cross-border routes with Asia-Pacific,
#BRICS
and
#EAEU
countries
. We are open to cooperation with all our partners in this area.
